eLabFTW Template Viewer (SFB1638)

How to use this page

Browse and search the available eLabFTW templates from the SFB 1638 template repository . For security reasons, the templates are displayed with their styling removed. When imported into eLabFTW, they may look different, but all content and information remain unchanged.

Use the filters below to narrow the list. If you use more than one filter, a template must match all of them to be shown. Excluding matches is not supported.

We plan to migrate the ELN files to eln.community once its API supports automated uploads. Until then, this page serves as an interim solution for browsing and viewing the templates stored in the GitHub repository.

If you encounter a bug or have a suggestion for improvement, feel free to open an issue or contact us using the details provided in the citation information .
